en: Collage-style black‑and‑white postcard showing four scenes of uniformed soldiers with rifles conducting shooting drills outside brick barracks. The men wear early‑20th‑century uniforms with peaked caps and long rifles with bayonets. Some scenes show soldiers kneeling and aiming from a grassy bank; others show them standing in a firing line in a courtyard beside long brick buildings. An officer in a long cloak appears in a couple of the views. The images look like formal training or demonstration photographs from a barracks or military school.
